'''Erimus Moayoi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] specializing as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply]] officer for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
